title: PAL monitors US flights amid FAA ground stop

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Airlines (PAL) said Saturday that its flights already airborne and bound for the United States would be allowed to proceed to their destinations despite air traffic disruptions following a ground stop imposed by the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).
